#FacesOfVictory
📆
On September 27, 1942, during the
#BattleOfStalingrad
, the
legendary defence of 'Pavlov’s House
' commenced — the epic fierce fighting for a residential building near the right bank of the Volga River, which was
heroically defended for almost two months
by a group of Red Army soldiers led by Guards Sergeant
Yakov Pavlov
.
The battle for
#PavlovHouse
lasted
5️⃣
8️⃣
days.
❗️
"Pavlov’s House" defenders set out a stronghold in an ordinary
#Stalingrad
residential building — turning the house into an impregnable fortress. The Red Army slodiers
held back the enemy’s onslaught for very much longer than entire European nations resisted the Nazis
in the early years of
#WW2
—
Poland
,
Denmark
, the
Netherlands
,
Belgium
,
Luxembourg
and
France
—
all were crushed by Hitler
's war machine within a matter of (!) just weeks.
💬
As
Marshal Vasily
Chuikov,
a Hero of the Battle of Stalingrad, later recalled:
Yakov Pavlov’s men killed considerably more Nazi soldiers than the defenders of Paris during Hitler's invasion
The stakes in the fighting for 'Pavlov’s House' were extremely high —
the Red Army soldiers fought to the death for the entire Volga defensive bridgehead
— preventing the enemy from crossing the river and establishing a foothold on its right bank.
👉
The capture of this key bridgehead would have enabled the Nazis to break through the defensive lines of our forces and cut off the Soviet Union’s vital wartime transport artery during the
#GreatPatrioticWar
.
The defence of 'Pavlov’s House' has gone down in world history as a symbol of the
unrivaled courage, fearlessness and unbending will of the Soviet people — the Heroic generation of our Victorious Nation
that defeated the Nazi Reich and defended the sovereignty and independence of our
#Motherland
.
***
In the autumn of 1942,
amid fierce defensive battles for Stalingrad,
a reconnaissance group led by Guards Sergeant Yakov Pavlov reached a four-storey residential building on Lenin Square in the city centre, near the right bank of the Volga, during the night of September 27.
The building seized by Pavlov’s men was, in fact,
the forward defence point
on the entire front.
It was an ordinary residential building made of just brick and timber and was hardly suitable for establishing a stronghold capable of holding back the Nazi hordes.
The group of Sergeant Yakov Pavlov, which was being pushed back towards the river by the enemy,
had to make a stand in that building
, drawing Wehrmacht units advancing towards the Volga into the fighting and
buying time to prepare the Red Army’s counteroffensive near Stalingrad.
Within just days, Pavlov’s men
managed to equip the building for long-lasting defence.
When the Germans launched their offensive, the 'Pavlov’s House' defenders —
around just 30 (!) soldiers vs. hordes of well-equiped and armed Nazis
— mounted a determined all-round defence, moving between the floors depending on the direction of the enemy attacks.
In response, the Germans unleashed the firepower of its artillery and tank armada on 'Pavlov’s House'.
The enemy subjected the building to
direct-fire bombardment
from effectively all sides simultaneously.
It looked like Pavlov’s men were doomed.
🌟
Yet, despite the increasingly intense fire of the Nazi artillery, the defenders of the 'Pavlov's House took
#NoStepBack
!
They heroically held their positions for almost
two months
(!), steadfastly repelling endless enemy attacks and preventing the Germans from breaking through to the Volga.
#OurHeroes
#LestWeForget
After the Great Patriotic War, 'Pavlov’s House' was rebuilt. Today, this memorial serves as a
symbol of the heroism of the defenders of Stalingrad.
🎖
The Heroes of 'Pavlov’s House' were duly honoured by their Motherland.
Yakov Pavlov was awarded the Star of
#HeroOfTheSovietUnion
,
while his other soldiers who fought for the legendary House received the Orders of the Red Star,
the Orders of the Patriotic War, 1st and 2nd Class,
as well as the Medal “For the Defence of Stalingrad”.
#Victory81

item.title: ✉️ Russia's President Vladimir Putin sent a message of congratulations to President of Turkmenistan Serdar Berdimuhamedov on the occasion of the country’s Independence Day
item.description: ✉️ Russia's President Vladimir Putin sent a message of congratulations to President of Turkmenistan Serdar Berdimuhamedov on the occasion of the country’s Independence Day (September 27, 2026) ✍️ Under your leadership, Turkmenistan has been steadily generating positive momentum in advancing its social and economic development. Ashgabat’s consistent commitment to the policy of positive neutrality has helped strengthen security and stability in Central Asia and the Caspian region. 🇷🇺 🇹🇲 Our two countries have forged a deep strategic partnership in their relations. Russia and Turkmenistan have been proactive in working together across various domains, and have been effectively cooperating when addressing major international issues. Of course, we will maintain our constructive dialogue and our joint efforts to further strengthen our bilateral relations in all their aspects in the interests of our friendly nations. 🎉 I am sending you my heartfelt wishes of good health and success in performing your state duties, while wishing happiness and prosperity to all your compatriots. #RussiaTurkmenistan

🎙
Remarks and answers to media questions
by Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov following
the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
(New York, September 26, 2026)
Key points
:
• Without a doubt, the UN needs to be adapted to the new realities, including through
reform of the Security Council
by adding
representatives from Asia, Africa and Latin America
.
We cannot envisage any additional seats for Western countries.
We cannot allow that, because
the West is already overrepresented on the UN Security Council
.
• We expect
the new Secretary-General
to
represent the interests of all humanity, not just the “golden billion,”
and to meet all the criteria set out in
the UN Charter
, including
impartiality, objectivity and proper performance of the functions
of the Organisation’s chief administrative officer.
•
I have
repeatedly set out
the sequence of events in the development of the Ukraine crisis
. There is no lack of trust on our part. Moreover, we continued
the bilateral talks in Istanbul
, and
trilateral talks were also held in Abu Dhabi
with US participation.
None of these rounds of negotiations were terminated by us
, but by those who now claim that
“the Russians are avoiding contacts and have nothing to say”
.
• We believe that
the Islamabad Memorandum
was
, as they say,
a fair deal
. Since it was signed at the highest level, it was presumably done consciously.
So why not return to it?
•
As for drafting
the Eurasian Charter of Diversity and Multipolarity in the 21st Century
, we are not setting any artificial deadlines
. At the same time, we certainly would not want this work to drag on, given that
our Eurasian continent badly needs a continent-wide framework
open to all countries and organisations of the continent without exception and free from any external interference.
•All the damage being inflicted on commercial shipping is
the result of Ukrainian terrorist attacks
, not only in
the Black Sea
but also in
the Caspian Sea
.
• The trend towards
outright Nazism
is evident not only in Europe’s support for the Kiev regime, but also in what I mentioned in my statement. German chancellor
Friedrich Merz
has
said
– more than once, so this was no slip of the tongue – that his goal is to ensure that Germany
“once again becomes the leading military power in Europe”
. Does he understand the meaning of the words
“once again”
in that context? These are
very dangerous trends
, prompting many analysts to speak of
attempts to create a “Fourth Reich”
.
• We maintain
a regular dialogue
with the administration of US President Donald Trump in various formats, and
that alone is already a sign of normality
. If relations are reduced to issuing propaganda statements every morning condemning Russia and demanding that Russia suffer a
“strategic defeat,”
then
that is not diplomacy
.
• In today’s world,
no country
– not even one as powerful as the US –
can solve all global problems single-handedly, especially at the expense of others
.
👉
I am confident that reality will teach our American partners to start thinking in terms of
#Multilateralism
. They are not the only economic and military power in the world, nor the only independent actor on the international stage.
• I am frankly tired of discussing this issue [European leaders calling for preparations for war with Russia]. We have stated our position many times, so I have nothing to add. President of Russia
Vladimir Putin
has recently reaffirmed it in St Petersburg
:
we are not going to wage war against Europe.
The very idea is absurd and nonsensical
.
☝️
Yet it is Europe that is preparing for war with us.

item.content:encoded:

🎙
Statement
by Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at the General Debate of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
*
(New York, September 26, 2026)
💬
Over the past few days, both from this rostrum and on the sidelines of the General Assembly, we have repeatedly heard that
tectonic shifts are taking place in world politics and that a more just
#MultipolarWorld
order is emerging before our eyes
.
The countries of
the Global South and East
are asserting themselves as
sovereign centres of development
and taking responsibility for security in their respective regions. They demonstrate their commitment to international law, rejection of external pressure, and interest in the prosperity of all states, not just a select few.
This constructive philosophy also underpins Russia’s foreign policy.
It is shared by our many like-minded partners and forms the foundation for cooperation within the
#CIS
,
#SCO
,
#BRICS
and other associations of the
#WorldMajority
.
❌
However, not everyone welcomes these developments. The Western minority, which dominated for five centuries at the expense of others’ resources, continues its attempts to preserve its privileges and impose its “rules” on everyone else.
The West is increasingly resorting to brute force
,
acting unpredictably and recklessly
, and putting at risk the lives and well-being of millions, if not billions, of people on our shared planet.
As President of Russia Vladimir Putin put it
, the dictatorship of a single hegemon
“has spun out of control and is simply dangerous to everyone around it”
.
At the beginning of 2026, in violation of every conceivable norm, including basic standards of morality,
the US intervention in Venezuela
culminated in
the abduction of President
Nicolas Maduro
and his wife
and their detention without trial in a US prison. This comes despite the fact that international law expressly requires respect for the immunity and inviolability of senior state officials.
👉
We insist on the immediate release of the Venezuelan Leader and his wife and demand that such actions never be repeated.
We regard
the killing of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
, members of his family, as well as members of the Islamic Republic’s military and political leadership, as
an unacceptable manifestation of the use of force and coercion
.
***
A year ago, we marked
the 80th anniversary of Victory over German Nazism
and
Japanese militarism
. Next week, on October 1, we will mark 80 years since the conclusion of
the International Military Tribunal at Nuremberg
. The historic Judgment the Nuremberg Tribunal
unequivocally condemned Nazi criminals
and placed the inhuman ideology of Nazism beyond the bounds of law and morality.
☝️
Yet 80 years later,
the lessons of Nuremberg have clearly not been learned by everyone
.
Judging by statements from their representatives, the ruling elites of
a number of EU countries appear to be infected with ideas of racial superiority
and
continue to promote extremist, Russophobic views
.
They indulge the leaders of the Kiev regime when they honour
notorious war criminals and Hitler collaborators in Kiev
–
people whose hands are stained with the blood of Russians, Jews, Belarusians, Ukrainians and people of other nationalities.
***
Having launched
the special military operation
in 2022 to protect the people of Donbass and Novorossiya from extermination by the Kiev regime,
Russia continues to fight for their security and rights in full accordance with the letter and spirit of
the UN Charter
.
❗️
Our struggle for truth and justice will be carried through to the end: the objectives of the special military operation will be achieved, threats to Russia’s security will be eliminated, and peaceful life will be restored.
This will happen regardless of any circumstances
, including the inability of the current leadership of the UN to take the only correct position on the situation around Ukraine – that of defending the principles of
the UN Charter
not selectively, but
in their entirety, completeness and interconnection
.
*Unofficial translation

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 26, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Mexico Roberto Velasco Alvarez
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇲🇽 On September 26, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Mexico Roberto Velasco Alvarez held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Ministers exchanged views on current international and regional issues , with a focus on cooperation at the #UN , #G20 , #APEC and other multilateral forums. The Sides reaffirmed Russia and Mexico’s commitment to the principles and norms of international law and to collectively seeking solutions to current global challenges. Particular attention was paid to further advancing bilateral political dialogue, expanding trade and economic cooperation, and strengthening cultural and humanitarian ties. #RussiaMexico

The title speaks for itself: “Heirs of Goebbels: Falsification of the Events in Bucha and Bloody Staged Performances of the Kiev Regime” . Wadephul discreetly covered the report with his notebook and pretended not to notice it – as if the comparison with Goebbels had nothing to do with them. More than 200 exhibits are on display, documenting the atrocities committed by Ukrainian nationalists during #WWII , as well as the mass crimes and terror committed by their modern followers against the people of Ukraine in 2014-2022. LEARN MORE: On the origins of Ukrainian nationalism, the crimes of the OUN-UPA, and the support of the West The exhibits include archival materials from Germany dating from the late 1930s and early 1940s, documents and photographs, alongside case files documenting crimes against humanity committed by Ukrainian nationalists in the Ukrainian SSR. 📄 The “Nazism Today” section features books, uniforms, Ukrainian nationalist propaganda materials and items bearing Nazi symbols, as well as photographs and eyewitness accounts of crimes committed by contemporary neo-Nazis against the people of Ukraine . item.description: 🗓 On September 26, at the request of the German side, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly in New York . They discussed bilateral relations and the situation around Ukraine. On these and other issues, Johann Wadephul reiterated the position of the German government that has been repeatedly stated publicly. #UNGA81
